questions.q: Which actor played Bruce Wayne in Tim Burton's first Batman film?
questions.why: Michael Keaton starred as the Caped Crusader opposite Jack Nicholson's Joker in Burton's 1989 blockbuster.

questions.q: What are the first names of the parents Bruce Wayne watched being murdered?
questions.why: Dr. Thomas Wayne and his wife Martha were killed in front of young Bruce, which drove him to become a vigilante.

questions.q: In which year did Batman debut in Detective Comics #27?
questions.why: Batman first appeared in Detective Comics #27, with the cover date of 1939, created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane.

questions.q: Who suggested the cowl, cape and gloves that darkened Bob Kane's first red-tights sketch of Batman?
questions.why: Collaborator Bill Finger reworked Kane's draft with a cowl, cape, gloves and darker colours, and made the hero a detective.

questions.q: In which year did Robin make his first appearance, in Detective Comics #38?
questions.why: Robin was introduced in Detective Comics #38 (April 1940) to lighten the tone, and sales nearly doubled.

questions.q: In which year did Alfred Pennyworth first appear in the comics, in issue 16 of his own title?
questions.why: Bruce's loyal butler Alfred debuted in Batman #16 in 1943, a few years after Batman and Robin were established.

questions.q: The Joker and Catwoman (then called 'The Cat') both debuted in which comic?
questions.why: Batman's first solo title, Batman #1 from 1940, introduced both the Joker and Selina Kyle's early Catwoman.

questions.q: Which Batman villain first appeared in Detective Comics #58 in December 1941?
questions.why: The Penguin debuted in Detective Comics #58 (December 1941); the Riddler and Two-Face arrived in later issues.

questions.q: In what year did Tim Drake, the third Robin in the main comics, first appear?
questions.why: Tim Drake first appeared in 1989, later starring in his own series and taking the Red Robin name.

questions.q: Who starred as Batman in the camp 1966 ABC television series?
questions.why: Adam West played Bruce Wayne and Batman, with Burt Ward as Robin, across three seasons and 120 episodes.
